source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

concepts.label: Cross Data Center Replication (XDCR)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - minted in metrics-reference.json, this batch. Deliberately namespaced capella: rather than service: because metrics-reference.md's own text excludes XDCR from 'all Couchbase Services' - confirms this batch's hypothesis that XDCR had not previously come up, and that it should not simply be folded into the service: family without checking source framing first

notable_absence.finding: Directly answers this batch's hypothesis question: this page is a flat list of xdcr_* Prometheus metric names (atr_txn_docs_filtered_total, binary_filtered_total, changes_left_total, client_txn_docs_filtered_total, clog_crd_docs_written_total, etc.) with version badges (7.0.0 through 8.0.0 observed) and one-line descriptions - no service-dependency prose. Some metric names (e.g. clog_crd_docs_written_total 'written to the conflict bucket') imply interaction with a bucket/Data Service, but this is a metric-naming artifact, not a documented dependsOnService statement, so no relation was extracted.

cross_component_finding: Reinforces the finding on metrics-reference.json (this batch): the source text's own top-level categorization treats XDCR as a peer of 'the Services' and 'the Cluster Manager', not a member of the service: family - a structural distinction worth preserving rather than collapsing for convenience.
